description: Closed set of motion patterns. Every PageSpec node declares one primary pattern (plus optional `additional` patterns where the section contract allows) and the pattern's locked reducedMotionFallback. Optional fields (durationMs, intervalMs, easing, trigger), when present, must equal the measured values below. Global hover micro-interactions (200ms) are owned by primitives/button.json and are not declared per node.
patternFieldNote: Only pattern, reducedMotionFallback, durationMs, intervalMs, easing and trigger are PageSpec motion properties (schema-closed, const-pinned). Documentation fields such as mechanism, iterations and cycleMsBySlot record the measured implementation; they are never set on a PageSpec node.

none.description: No motion beyond global hover micro-interactions.

header-menus.description: Sign-in menu reveal (300ms out-expo, rows staggered 50/100/150ms) and drawer slide (300ms ease-out); nav dropdowns appear instantly.

carousel-crossfade.description: 10s autoplay per slide while >=50% in view; 500ms ease dissolve of copy and art; 2px progress fill (10s, progress easing); user selection or focus stops autoplay.

logo-fade-in.description: Each logo fades in once on mount.

logo-rotate.description: Every 2000ms one random cell fades out (500ms), stays blank, then fades in a logo not on screen (+1000ms).

video-viewport-gated.description: Illustrated in-page demo (the /go feature-row videos) loops while >=20% in view (IntersectionObserver [0, 0.2]); pauses once fully out of view; manual play/pause control. Under reduced motion every illustration shows a complete static frame. Product-page hero demos use hero-video-loop instead.

hero-video-loop.description: Product-page hero demo (/mail, /docs, /go) that loops continuously: infinite iterations of one cycle per slot (cycleMsBySlot; the /docs collaborator cursor runs half a cycle, 14150ms, so it completes twice per cycle). The /mail and /docs cycles are seamless: the first and last keyframes are the same complete scene. Viewport-gated by VideoSlot: pauses when fully out of view, resumes at >=20% visible; manual play/pause. Keyframes are declared only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, and illustrations.css strips all .ns-art animation under reduce, so the locked fallback is the static complete scene. Distinct from the homepage carousel's hero-video-oneshot.

hero-video-oneshot.description: Homepage carousel slide art (hero-video-1..3): one 7000ms timeline per slide activation, iteration-count 1, fill forwards (holds its last frame); Hero.jsx re-keys the art so the timeline restarts each time a slide becomes active. Never loops. Under reduced motion the motion-only elements are removed and the complete final frame shows. Only ever an `additional` pattern on hero.carousel, whose primary pattern is carousel-crossfade.

mechanism.primary: CSS scroll-driven animation: .pin-row sets view-timeline-name: --pin-row; .pin-text runs pin-slide, pin-fade-in and pin-fade-out (linear, duration auto) on animation-timeline: --pin-row, with base opacity 0 / visibility hidden.
mechanism.window: animation-range cover calc(50vh - 33.5px) to cover calc(100% - 50vh - 33.5px): the row's height h, centred in the viewport below the 67px header (33.5 = 67 / 2).
mechanism.slide: pin-slide translateY(-50%) -> translateY(50%) over the window (the text column is stretched to the row, so +-h/2).
mechanism.fadeIn: pin-fade-in over the first 200px of the window (cover calc(50vh - 33.5px) -> cover calc(50vh + 166.5px)).
mechanism.fadeOut: pin-fade-out over the last 200px (cover calc(100% - 50vh - 233.5px) -> cover calc(100% - 50vh - 33.5px)); listed last so it wins once active.
mechanism.fallback: When CSS.supports('animation-timeline: view()') is false, StickyFeatureRow.jsx runs the JS scroll/rAF version of the same window (FADE_PX 200, HEADER_H 67) under the same media query; when it is true the JS hook returns early.

sticky-pinned-text.description: Text column is pinned at the visible centre while its row scrolls through: it translates +-h/2 against the scroll and fades in over the first 200px and out over the last 200px of the window. Implemented as a named view-timeline (--pin-row) scroll-driven animation, with a JS scroll/rAF fallback for browsers without view timelines. Only >=640.02px under no-preference; static, readable text otherwise.

accordion-expand.description: Panel grid-rows 0fr<->1fr + opacity and caret -180deg over 200ms ease, motion-safe only.

floating-header-slide.description: Fixed plan header slides translateY(-110%)<->0 when the comparison header reaches 71px and until its end rises to 170px.

tooltip-fade.description: Tooltip mounts 200ms after hover/focus and fades in .2s; hides instantly.

smooth-scroll-anchor.description: Compare button smooth-scrolls to the comparison with scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth'}), behaviour 'auto' under reduced motion. The scroll duration is chosen by the browser (about 0.79s observed for this jump), so it is not a contract value. See siteWide.smoothScroll for the page-wide default.

cta-art-drift.description: Slow CSS drift of the closing-CTA background art (stands in for the original's animated GIF); the static gradient remains under reduced motion.

siteWide.note: Page-level motion facts that apply to every route. They are owned by the site shell, not declared per node, and a PageSpec cannot change them.

smoothScroll.reducedMotion: Not declared, so the browser default (instant jumps) applies.
smoothScroll.routeChanges: ScrollToTop calls window.scrollTo({ top: 0, left: 0, behavior: 'instant' }) on every pathname change, overriding the smooth default so route changes jump to the top.
smoothScroll.inPageAnchors: In-page scrolls (the /plans compare button, pattern smooth-scroll-anchor) animate; their duration is browser-chosen and not pinned.
